prompt: Which capabilities are available only on Redis Cloud Pro and on no Essentials plan?
explanation: The Redis Cloud plan comparison reserves encryption at rest and private connectivity for Redis Cloud Pro, and Active-Active geo-distribution is also Pro only. TLS encryption in transit and password-protected role-based access are available on every plan, including Free Redis Cloud Essentials, and Redis Flex is offered on both Essentials (as Essentials with Redis Flex) and Pro.

options.text: TLS encryption of data in transit
